firmware.title: USB Wi-Fi adapter
firmware.about: Turns the S3 into a plain USB network card for the handheld: it joins a Wi-Fi (a Stump's, for FireFly) and the handheld reaches it over usb0. Firmware in progress (Team RK3326 Provisioner memo, 2026-11-02).

firmware.title: RNode (LoRa radio)
firmware.about: RNode firmware and the mesh's radio settings, offline. Next step: bundling the RNode release and setting it up without rnodeconf's online wizard.
